title: Liverpool's Champions League scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most Champions League goals for Liverpool since 1992/93.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards
checks: Each player total is the sum of his goals for the club in every season, from UEFA.com season stats and from Transfermarkt season scorer lists; the two agree on every figure shown unless the value gives both. UEFA.com files a mid-season mover's whole season under his later club, so those seasons were split using Transfermarkt game logs. Gerrard's goals in qualifying rounds are not counted. Luis Diaz: UEFA.com lists 8 because it files his 2021/22 season (2 goals for Porto before his January move) under Liverpool; Transfermarkt game logs give 6 for Liverpool.
